snippet.title: Drifter Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Drifter is a space trading game by Celsius Game Studios featuring a massive galaxy with tens of thousands of star systems where you can trade, explore, mine, hunt pirates, or even become a pirate yourself!

Check it out at: http://celsiusgs.com/drifter/
